issue: Purchased units are ~100x the units sold
action: Ask the company which unit is used (piece / dozen / kg). Use PO data for comparisons only.

issue: Quantity bought per SKU does not follow its sales
action: Replace with a demand-driven purchase plan (forecast + safety stock).

issue: Branches receive far more than they sell
action: Allocate to branches by their real sales (demand-based allocation).

issue: Branches receive goods from the raw-material and returns warehouses
action: Only finished-goods / distribution warehouses should ship to branches.

issue: Discounts do not increase the quantity sold
evidence: 54% of lines discounted; avg qty 2.99 vs 2.98
action: Stop random discounts; run discounts only as measured tests.

issue: Campaigns claim far more orders than exist
action: Judge campaigns by cost per click / CTR and by holdout tests, never by attributed orders.

issue: Orders dated before the branch opened
action: Confirm the real opening dates with the company; keep the orders.

issue: All branches sell almost the same
action: No branch ranking or location decision is built on this data.

issue: "Delayed" status is not linked to delivery time
evidence: 428 'Delayed' delivered in ≤1 day; 13,512 'on time' took 7 days
action: No delivery-delay KPI until the carrier data is fixed.

issue: Delivery time is the same for every governorate
action: Collect real carrier scan dates.

issue: Free shipping is given at random, even on very small orders
evidence: 14% free overall; 14% for the smallest 25% of orders
action: Free shipping only above a minimum order value.

issue: Every payment is on the order day, even cash on delivery
action: Payments table is a copy of orders: no cash-collection analysis.

issue: "Partial receipt" never closes
action: Not reported as late deliveries.

issue: "In transit" never closes
evidence: 6% in transit + 2% partial, every year since 2018
action: Not reported as stuck transfers.

issue: Transport cost is random (7 fixed values)
evidence: 7 distinct values; same cost for any distance
action: Use the count of transfers, not the cost per trip, for savings.

issue: Monthly stock does not move with what came in and went out
evidence: total closing stock 1.64M – 1.91M units for 8 years
action: Ask which is right: stock snapshots or transfers + sales. Stock is used for shares only.

issue: Salary does not depend on the job
evidence: avg salary by role 11,539 – 12,487 EGP; area manager < cashier
action: No salary benchmarking until HR data is fixed.

issue: Roles are assigned in rotation: half the branches have no manager, half no cashier
evidence: 40 branches without a store manager, 40 without a cashier
action: Ask HR for the real org chart.

issue: Payroll is incomplete
evidence: 10 of 640 employees paid in the last month
action: Payroll totals are not used for cost analysis.

issue: Rent is missing in most months for each branch
evidence: each branch has rent in 39 of 97 months on average (25–64)
action: Ask finance for the full rent ledger.

issue: Marketing cost in the expenses ledger ≠ campaign spend
evidence: 11.8M EGP in expenses vs 219.5M in campaigns
action: One source of truth for marketing spend (finance ledger).

issue: Supplier type does not match what they supply
evidence: 10 supplier types, all supplying finished garments
action: Clean the supplier master.

issue: Import freight does not depend on container or country
action: No landed-cost model until real freight invoices are available.

issue: Import value is far larger than all sales
action: Ask the company what the import rows represent.

issue: Factories are not linked to any other table
action: Production / factory apps cannot be built until production data exists.

issue: Products on the website never appear in sales
action: Ask if they are new products.

issue: Return reasons are spread evenly (random)
action: Only the total return rate is used; reasons need a real capture form.

issue: One customer ID shops in many branches and governorates
evidence: customers with 5+ store visits used 7.3 different branches on average
action: Loyalty ID at the till (phone number) before any personalisation.
